AUTH-01.subject: You are invited to KRAVIA Office
AUTH-01.body: Your authorised KRAVIA Office invitation was issued. Use its existing secure registration flow; an invitation does not activate employment.

AUTH-02.triggerProposal: Still PENDING near expiry; one opt-in reminder
AUTH-02.subject: Reminder: Your KRAVIA Office invitation expires soon
AUTH-02.body: An issued Office invitation is awaiting registration and is approaching its recorded expiry. Use only the original verified invitation link.

AUTH-03.subject: Your KRAVIA Office invitation has expired
AUTH-03.body: The previously issued Office invitation has expired. Request a fresh invitation from an authorised access administrator; the expired link cannot be used.

AUTH-04.subject: Your KRAVIA Office account is registered
AUTH-04.body: Your Office account registration was recorded. Any employee onboarding, role entitlement or active employment remains subject to separate verification.

AUTH-05.triggerProposal: Password session requests email OTP, eligible account only
AUTH-05.subject: Your KRAVIA Office verification code
AUTH-05.body: A verification challenge was requested for your eligible account. Use the protected sign-in flow; never share a code by email or message.

AUTH-06.subject: Review a new KRAVIA Office device sign-in
AUTH-06.body: An unrecognised device access request requires review. Verify the device and context in your private Office security workspace before approving.

AUTH-07.subject: KRAVIA Office device review update
AUTH-07.body: A decision was recorded for a device access request. Review the recorded decision and current trusted devices in Office Settings.

AUTH-08.triggerProposal: Explicit authorised recovery or verified self-service request
AUTH-08.subject: Reset your KRAVIA Office password
AUTH-08.body: An authorised password recovery action was recorded. Follow only the private recovery link issued through the verified Office channel.

AUTH-09.subject: Your KRAVIA Office password was changed
AUTH-09.body: Your Office account password-change event was recorded. Review active sessions and report an unexpected change to your security administrator.

AUTH-10.subject: Security alert for your KRAVIA Office account
AUTH-10.body: A security monitoring event needs attention. Inspect the verified alert and account sessions before taking any action.

AUTH-11.subject: KRAVIA Office access status updated
AUTH-11.body: A committed change to your Office access or sessions was recorded. Contact your authorised administrator if the change was unexpected.

AUTH-12.triggerProposal: Verified MFA enrollment or approved factor reset
AUTH-12.subject: Your KRAVIA Office sign-in protection changed
AUTH-12.body: Your Office authenticator or MFA configuration changed following an authorised action. Review your approved sign-in methods and trusted devices.

HIRE-01.subject: Application received — KRAVIA
HIRE-01.body: Your application has been recorded in KRAVIA's recruitment system. Further review and any employment decision remain subject to the hiring process.

HIRE-02.subject: Interview details — KRAVIA
HIRE-02.body: An interview appointment was confirmed in the recruitment record. Consult the verified schedule and instructions provided by the hiring team.

HIRE-03.subject: Updated interview schedule — KRAVIA
HIRE-03.body: A previously confirmed interview has a newly recorded schedule. Use the updated verified details rather than the superseded appointment.

HIRE-04.subject: Update to your KRAVIA interview
HIRE-04.body: A scheduled interview has been cancelled. Review any follow-up instructions from the authorised hiring team.

HIRE-05.subject: Document request for your KRAVIA application
HIRE-05.body: Additional application documents have been formally requested. Submit only the specifically requested items through the approved private channel.

HIRE-06.triggerProposal: Document reviewer rejects or requests new evidence
HIRE-06.subject: Action required: Your KRAVIA document
HIRE-06.body: A submitted recruitment document needs correction or replacement. Review the authorised reviewer comments and resubmission requirements.

HIRE-07.subject: Approval required: KRAVIA offer
HIRE-07.body: A proposed offer awaits independent director or delegated approval. This notification does not represent an approved employment offer.

HIRE-08.triggerProposal: Approved document signed/published with candidate access
HIRE-08.subject: Your KRAVIA offer letter is ready
HIRE-08.body: Your approved offer document is available through the authorised recruitment document route. Review the verified offer before accepting.

HIRE-09.triggerProposal: Acceptance is actually recorded and verified
HIRE-09.subject: KRAVIA offer acceptance confirmed
HIRE-09.body: Your offer response has been recorded and verified in the recruitment system. Joining arrangements are governed separately.

HIRE-10.subject: Update on your KRAVIA offer
HIRE-10.body: A recorded offer status has changed. Review the authorised decision; this message does not create or terminate employment on its own.

ONB-01.triggerProposal: Active employee identity + accepted employment + director-approved joining
ONB-01.subject: Welcome aboard KRAVIA, {{employee_first_name}}
ONB-01.body: Your approved joining arrangements are now recorded. Review the position, effective date, responsibilities and required onboarding steps privately.

ONB-02.triggerProposal: Onboarding workflow starts, assigned tasks exist
ONB-02.subject: Your KRAVIA joining checklist
ONB-02.body: Your employment onboarding checklist contains outstanding required items. Review each task and submit the supporting evidence through Office.

ONB-03.subject: Your KRAVIA appointment letter is available
ONB-03.body: An approved appointment document has been signed and made available in the private document vault. View it using your authorised Office access.

ONB-04.triggerProposal: Document requires signature; permitted signing link issued
ONB-04.subject: Signature requested: KRAVIA appointment documents
ONB-04.body: An authorised electronic-signature request is awaiting your action. Use only the approved signing workflow; a typed name alone is not a completed signature.

ONB-05.triggerProposal: Checklist evidence reaches reviewer or is returned
ONB-05.subject: KRAVIA onboarding document review update
ONB-05.body: Your onboarding evidence reached a new documented review state. Check reviewer comments and any requested resubmission.

ONB-06.triggerProposal: Actual joining date and work arrangement confirmed
ONB-06.subject: Your first day at KRAVIA
ONB-06.body: Your verified joining date and work arrangement are available. Review the published first-day instructions in your private workspace.

ONB-07.triggerProposal: Verified device/asset assignment or provisioning change
ONB-07.subject: Your KRAVIA work setup is ready
ONB-07.body: An assigned work device or application account has a recorded readiness update. Check the authorised asset assignment before relying on access.

ONB-08.subject: Please acknowledge your KRAVIA policies
ONB-08.body: A current version of a company policy requires acknowledgement. Review the published policy version and record the acknowledgement in Office.

ONB-09.triggerProposal: Role package actually applied and scoped permissions verified
ONB-09.subject: Your KRAVIA roles and responsibilities
ONB-09.body: Your approved job responsibilities and assigned access scope are available in KRAVIA Office. Review outstanding role acknowledgements.

ONB-10.triggerProposal: All required checklist items verified and governance approved
ONB-10.subject: KRAVIA onboarding completed
ONB-10.body: All required onboarding steps have received the necessary independent verification. Review your employment and access status in Office.

ONB-11.triggerProposal: 7th calendar day after actual joining, if employed
ONB-11.subject: Your first-week check-in at KRAVIA
ONB-11.body: A first-week onboarding check-in has been recorded for your verified start date. Review any open questions with your reporting manager.

ONB-12.triggerProposal: 30th day after actual joining, if employed
ONB-12.subject: Your first-month check-in at KRAVIA
ONB-12.body: A first-month onboarding check-in has been recorded for your verified start date. Review development needs and outstanding onboarding evidence.

ROLE-01.triggerProposal: Canonical role package applied / job changed
ROLE-01.subject: Your KRAVIA responsibilities have been updated
ROLE-01.body: A governed functional responsibility or position assignment was recorded. Review its effective scope and acknowledgements; statutory appointments remain separate.

ROLE-02.triggerProposal: Verified access-profile or scoped permission change
ROLE-02.subject: KRAVIA Office access permissions changed
ROLE-02.body: Your scoped Office permissions have changed through the authorised access process. Check what is now available or restricted.

ROLE-03.subject: Your reporting structure at KRAVIA
ROLE-03.body: An approved change to your reporting relationship is on record. Review the new reporting manager and any pending handover responsibilities.

ROLE-04.subject: Department ownership transfer awaiting acceptance
ROLE-04.body: A department ownership handover has been proposed and is awaiting the receiving head's formal acceptance. No transfer is effective yet.

ROLE-05.triggerProposal: Receiving head accepts; former owner write rights checked
ROLE-05.subject: Department ownership transfer completed
ROLE-05.body: The receiving head accepted an approved department handover. Operational mutation authority must now follow the new owner and the former owner is read-only where permitted.

ROLE-06.subject: KRAVIA department transfer update
ROLE-06.body: A requested department ownership transfer was rejected or expired. The previous valid ownership authority remains in force.

ROLE-07.subject: Access review required — KRAVIA Office
ROLE-07.body: An independent review of privileged Office access is required. Use the assigned access-review workflow and supporting evidence.

ROLE-08.subject: KRAVIA access review decision
ROLE-08.body: A governed access-review decision is available. Review any permission changes, acknowledgement requirements or follow-up actions.

ROLE-09.triggerProposal: New role-package version applied to employee
ROLE-09.subject: Your KRAVIA role package has been updated
ROLE-09.body: A new approved role-package version was applied to your Office identity. Review its responsibilities and scoped access.

TIME-01.subject: Your KRAVIA work schedule
TIME-01.body: An approved work schedule or effective-dated shift policy was updated. Check the current contractual working pattern and any requested acknowledgement.

TIME-02.triggerProposal: Scheduled reminder; no approved/open check-in by cutoff
TIME-02.subject: Please review your KRAVIA attendance
TIME-02.body: A recorded attendance day may need your review. Check actual check-in and check-out evidence; browser activity is not payable attendance.

TIME-03.subject: Attendance correction awaiting review
TIME-03.body: An attendance correction request was submitted for independent review. No correction is payable until verified and approved.

TIME-04.subject: Your attendance correction was reviewed
TIME-04.body: An independent reviewer recorded a decision on your attendance correction. Review the supporting evidence and revised worktime totals.

TIME-05.subject: Overtime request awaiting review
TIME-05.body: An overtime evidence request needs independent review under the effective-dated policy. Requested hours are not yet approved.

TIME-06.triggerProposal: Recorded reviewer decision, approved policy in force
TIME-06.subject: Your KRAVIA overtime request was reviewed
TIME-06.body: An independent overtime decision has been recorded. Only verified approved minutes and the effective policy can affect earnings.

TIME-07.triggerProposal: Five distinct approved six-hour weekdays, approved Flex policy
TIME-07.subject: Your KRAVIA Flex Day eligibility
TIME-07.body: Your approved worktime evidence may qualify for a Flex Day under the current five-day policy. Eligibility is not the same as leave approval.

TIME-08.subject: Your KRAVIA Flex Day request update
TIME-08.body: Your Flex Day request received an authorised decision. Review the actual leave credit and remaining balance in Office.

TIME-09.triggerProposal: Real request or reviewer decision recorded
TIME-09.subject: KRAVIA leave request update
TIME-09.body: A leave request or independent decision was recorded. Confirm the approved dates and schedule implications in your private calendar.

TIME-10.subject: Attendance review closes soon
TIME-10.body: The worktime review cutoff for an actual payroll period is approaching. Review any missing or disputed attendance evidence.

PAY-01.subject: Compensation proposal requires approval
PAY-01.body: A compensation proposal awaits independent approval. Draft pay figures must not be treated as your approved salary.

PAY-02.subject: Your KRAVIA compensation record was updated
PAY-02.body: A compensation decision was recorded against the effective-dated salary policy. Review the verified terms in your private payroll records.

PAY-03.subject: KRAVIA payroll period is open
PAY-03.body: An actual payroll period has been opened for preparation. Figures remain provisional until the required validations and approvals.

PAY-04.triggerProposal: Locked review request sent to independent approver
PAY-04.subject: KRAVIA payroll approval required
PAY-04.body: A payroll calculation needs independent review. Verify attendance, rate-policy effective dates and lawful deductions before approving.

PAY-05.triggerProposal: All required approvals completed and results locked
PAY-05.subject: KRAVIA payroll run approved
PAY-05.body: An approved payroll run was locked by the authorised reviewers. Bank settlement remains a separate verification step.

PAY-06.subject: Your KRAVIA payslip for {{pay_period}} is ready
PAY-06.body: An immutable approved payslip is available for the specified payroll period. Issuing a slip does not confirm a bank credit.

PAY-07.subject: KRAVIA salary batch prepared — not yet paid
PAY-07.body: A payroll payment batch has been prepared but not bank-verified. Do not classify these wages as paid.

PAY-08.triggerProposal: Independent bank settlement verification covers full net salary
PAY-08.subject: KRAVIA salary payment confirmed — {{pay_period}}
PAY-08.body: A salary payment has been independently confirmed by bank settlement evidence. Review the verified payment classification in Office.

PAY-09.triggerProposal: Verified credit is less than net; remaining amount owed
PAY-09.subject: Important: Outstanding KRAVIA salary balance
PAY-09.body: A verified partial salary credit leaves an outstanding wage balance. The remaining amount remains payable and should be reviewed in the private payroll ledger.

PAY-10.triggerProposal: Pay date passed with independently unverified balance
PAY-10.subject: Salary payment follow-up for {{pay_period}}
PAY-10.body: The recorded wage due date has passed with an outstanding or unverified balance. The unpaid claim remains recorded pending independent settlement.

PAY-11.triggerProposal: New approved correction/adjustment and new immutable issue
PAY-11.subject: Updated KRAVIA payslip available
PAY-11.body: An approved correction to an immutable payslip has been issued. Review the new issue and its documented adjustment history.

PAY-12.intent: Annual wage or statutory statement ready
PAY-12.triggerProposal: Approved statement exists in private Office vault
PAY-12.subject: Your annual KRAVIA payroll statement is available
PAY-12.body: Your approved annual wage or statutory payroll statement is available in the private Office document vault.

DEV-01.subject: Training assigned in KRAVIA Office
DEV-01.body: An approved training programme has been assigned to your role. Review the learning objectives, schedule and required evidence.

DEV-02.triggerProposal: Approved due date approaching and incomplete
DEV-02.subject: KRAVIA training due soon
DEV-02.body: An assigned training activity is approaching its recorded due date and remains incomplete. Review the requirement or request an extension.

DEV-03.subject: Training completion review update
DEV-03.body: Your submitted training evidence received an independent reviewer decision. Check any required correction or completion state.

DEV-04.subject: Your KRAVIA performance review
DEV-04.body: A governed performance or development review was scheduled. Review the meeting details and reviewer assignment.

DEV-05.triggerProposal: Review finalised and released to employee
DEV-05.subject: Your KRAVIA development review is ready
DEV-05.body: A finalised authorised development-review outcome is available in your private records. This notice does not disclose confidential findings.

DEV-06.subject: Your KRAVIA development plan
DEV-06.body: An approved development plan was published. Review its agreed milestones, responsible reviewer and due dates.

DEV-07.subject: Action assigned in KRAVIA Office
DEV-07.body: An authorised task or approval was assigned to you. Check the task ledger and confirm whether you have decision authority.

DEV-08.triggerProposal: Versioned document released to recipient's scope
DEV-08.subject: KRAVIA policy or document update
DEV-08.body: A versioned policy or document was released to your permitted scope. Read the current version and complete required acknowledgements.

EXIT-01.subject: KRAVIA employee offboarding review
EXIT-01.body: A governed employee departure case has been initiated for authorised review. No end-of-employment date is inferred from a draft request.

EXIT-02.triggerProposal: Confirmed notice and final-day details recorded
EXIT-02.subject: Your KRAVIA exit process
EXIT-02.body: Your confirmed departure arrangements and effective dates were recorded. Review outstanding company, asset and employment obligations.

EXIT-03.subject: KRAVIA equipment return checklist
EXIT-03.body: A registered company asset is due for return through the verified custody process. Follow the formal handover record.

EXIT-04.subject: KRAVIA Office access removed
EXIT-04.body: Your Office sessions and entitlements were revoked under an authorised employment process. Request permitted post-employment records through the designated secure channel.

EXIT-05.subject: KRAVIA final settlement under review
EXIT-05.body: Your final employment settlement is being independently reviewed. Unverified calculations or prepared payment batches do not establish payment.

EXIT-06.subject: KRAVIA final settlement confirmed
EXIT-06.body: Independent bank evidence confirms the final settlement specified by the authorised payroll record. Retain the verified settlement reference.

EXIT-07.subject: Your KRAVIA employment document is ready
EXIT-07.body: An approved and signed employment document is available for authorised retrieval. Use the secure post-employment evidence process if Office access ended.

EXIT-08.triggerProposal: People, assets and access steps complete
EXIT-08.subject: KRAVIA exit process completed
EXIT-08.body: Your documented offboarding checklist is complete following authorised reviews. Any outstanding lawful wage or document claim remains enforceable.
